user.title: Add a Valetudo vacuum
user.description: Choose the vacuum entity created by Valetudo's MQTT discovery. You can fine-tune every automation after the integration has been added.

init.title: Valetudo Essentials
init.description: Choose a section to configure. Switches on the integration's device enable or disable each automation at runtime.

general.title: General
general.description: Shared settings used by the built-in automations.

data_description.presence_entity: Usually zone.home, but a person, device tracker, input_boolean, or binary_sensor also works. Zone states are treated as occupied when greater than zero.
data_description.fan_entity: Valetudo exposes fan speed as a select entity. Leave empty to discover it automatically.
data_description.fan_speed: Applied before every automated cleaning start.
data_description.notify_service: For example notify.mobile_app_phone. Persistent notifications are used when empty or unavailable.
data_description.post_run_service: For example script.after_vacuum. Leave empty to skip.
data_description.auto_empty_entity: Leave empty to discover the Valetudo 'Trigger Auto Empty Dock' button automatically.

away.title: Clean when away
away.description: Starts cleaning after everybody leaves. The vacuum must be docked and have enough battery.

home.title: Dock when home
home.description: What to do when the first person comes home during a run.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.description: Starts and runs inside this window are paused or sent home. The window may cross midnight.

data.quiet_resume: Resume a run paused by quiet hours

data_description.quiet_resume: Only applies when quiet hours paused the vacuum. A run sent to the dock is not restarted.

schedule.title: Weekly schedule
schedule.description: Runs on the selected days at the selected time. Skipped if the vacuum is not docked or the battery is too low.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Leave a service empty to use the default from the General section. If no service is available, a persistent notification is created instead.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Checks consumable and dock supply sensors once a day.

data_description.maintenance_sensors: Leave empty to auto-discover percentage sensors on the vacuum's device, such as brushes, filters, mop pads, dustbags, and dock tanks.

error.invalid_service: Use the format domain.service, for example notify.mobile_app_phone.
error.same_times: The start and end of quiet hours must be different.
